fields.System.Title: INB-201 — Start a receipt against an open ASN
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to open a receipt against an ASN, so that I have
somewhere to record what actually came off the truck.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an open ASN, when I start a receipt, then a draft receipt is created with a
  • line per outstanding ASN line and a receiving location assigned.
  • - Given an ASN that already has an open receipt, then I am given that receipt rather
  • than a second one.
  • - Given a cancelled ASN, then starting a receipt is rejected.
  • - Given the receipt, then it records the dock, the vehicle reference, and who started it.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | receipt, receipt_line |
| Risks | Two clerks opening two receipts for one delivery |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency |
